sources.name: Food Safety Inspection Body of Armenia (SNUND) - veterinary page
sources.note: Official body; page describes state veterinary control only, no clinic register. Hotline 118 is the inspection body's line, not an emergency vet line.

sources.note: Says a university veterinary clinic will also serve the public; no clinic address, hours or 24 h statement. Centre contact: Teryan 74, +374 12 585808.

sources.name: HayWiki - vet clinics in Armenia
sources.note: Community wiki (not official). Used only as leads: names VetLine, VetExpert, AmiryanVet as round-the-clock with only basic night care; also Gyumri (Vet Vat, MyVet) and Vanadzor (Shunn u Katun) clinics. Not used as a source for any entry.

entries.name: VetExpert Veterinary Group

Mobile numbers +374 96 209966, +374 95 209060. HayWiki (not a source) says night care is basic stabilisation only. Checked 2026-11-12: page hours 9:00-24:00 contradict the 24-hour admission claim, so not listed as 24 h.

notes: Armenia has no official register of small-animal clinics: the Food Safety Inspection Body (snund.am) pages describe state veterinary control only, its 118 hotline is not an emergency vet line, and the agrarian university's public clinic is only announced (no address or hours). No animal poison line and no duty rota were found. Follow-up 2026-11-12: Shunn u Katun (Vanadzor) entered from its own site. Still NOT entered: VetLife (Facebook vetlifearmenia blocked by robots; no own site found; areg/yell/spyur list it as 24 h but only aggregators), VetLine (vetline.am not fetchable: not returned by search, only aggregators 2gis/yell/pages/yerevanguide found), AmiryanVet (Amiryan 10; Facebook blocked by robots, only profibank.am listing which has no hours/24 h claim), Vet Vat and Best Clinic (Gyumri; Facebook only, robots-blocked), Van Veterinary Clinic (Facebook, robots-blocked), Paws Pet Medical Center (Dilijan, Getapnya 6/1, +374 44 994299; only a Yandex Maps listing, no own page), Dilijan municipal stray-dog clinic (news article only), nothing found for Tsaghkadzor and Sevan. Other Yerevan leads from the first run (Vahe Mkrtchyan, AlphaVet, Oscar Vet, Quercus, DoctorVet, New Vet, Vetpoint, Maltese City) not retried. turn.am 'Abamyan vet' marketplace page, janvelyan.com (robots) and yerevanzoo clinic (redirect loop) skipped as before.
